extraction.Name: Nellie Whalen
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, on account of not wishing to pay taxes, but that she received it in the mail, accepted it and signed for it, having been previously advised that it would be better for her
extraction.Buyer: her brother-in-law, Herbert Mc Bissonette, got this land from her, and said that he would sell it for her to one Mr. James Good; that she never signed any mortgage or deed dealing away this allotment; and that Messrs., Bissonette and Good have cheated her
extraction.Occupation/Income: supports herself by doing domestic work; half-time work
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent; health is good except for severe rheumatism; was left a widow after receiving patent in fee; has no person else to support; has no other income than her small wages; never received any aid from County or Government; her only abode is a tent in Chadron, Nebraska; document sworn November 12, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (reservation not explicitly named)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
